<reason>CON won a close debate by making the live comparison easier to decide: the proposed notice is not a usable consent tool. PRO’s inventory/consent frame stayed principled and memorable, but never showed a concrete move the lonely user can execute that they cannot already approximate, especially if every matcher ranks. CON’s fusion/no-clean-seam attack and the empty-of-guidance vs loaded-as-story split survived pressure and undercut stay/pay/leave.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s R2 A1/A2: the notice is empty of executable choice yet loaded as a machine-verdict and gamer signal, which defused PRO’s contradiction and recast stay/pay/leave as quitting dating rather than informed consent.</best_rebuttal>
